headline: Wardens Gain Foothold on Linn Mercy as Expanse Battle Grinds On
war_summary: Wardens have planted two colours on the Linn Mercy front since the previous edition, cutting the Colonial tally there to eight works with one stretch unclaimed; five actions fell in the last two hours and thirteen across the day about Outwich Ranch and Lathair. Elsewhere the picture is grinding rather than movement. Mooring County, the last edition's hottest ledger, has cooled sharply: Colonial losses have dropped from some 208 an hour to 92, Warden from 105 to 39, while the line holds at eleven Warden works to one. Weathered Expanse remains the war's largest sustained engagement — six Warden works, one Colonial, two unclaimed — with fifty-one actions in the day and one in the last two hours around Crow's Nest, Spirit Watch and Wightwalk, casualties near 82 Colonial and 55 Warden an hour. The Nevish Line stands at seven Warden works to one, fifty-six actions logged in the day but none in the last two hours. Kuura Strand has stirred after its quiet spell, ten actions in the day at Talven and Faden Point. Losses without change of colours continue in the Dead Lands, Callahan's Passage, Stlican Shelf and Stonecradle.
